page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, with the page number at its left. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: locum Psal. II. 7. qui tamen vel de adoptio-ne Davidis ipsius, vel certe de resurrectio-ne Christi, teste Paulo Act. xiii. 33. aut constitutione in Pontificem Hebr. v. 5. videatur intelligendus. Ubi hoc ipso capite & sequenti loca quædam alia è vete-ri Instrumento, Psalmis imprimis, cum citantur, tũ applicantur, quæ videri possent non usq; adeò cum verbis aut mente scriptoris consona. Ubi Cap. ix. 4. præter fidem historiæ, urnam & virgam Aharonis in arca Fœderis repositam, quemadmodum v. 19. præter Moisis verba Exod. xxiv. 8. non populū tantùm, sed & librum, & quidem cum aqua, lana coccina & hyssopo conspersum memorat: Ut præterea quæ istius generis & Iudæis fidem Epistolæ derogandi, & Samosatenianis oggannien-di, & profanis cavillandi, & multis, ipsi Cajetano, Epistolæ authoritate vertendi in controversiam, [?] sane omnibus, Petro teste, [?] occasionem præbuêre.
VI. Sed de his plus satis conciliandæ argumento nostro fidei. Nec excipiat aliquis, non minus [?] in Paulinis aliis,

page.notes: Greek words in the first and second paragraph are not certain: the first looks like a form of στρεβλ- and the second like ἀμαθεῖς, but the scan is too blurred to read them letter by letter. The Greek in the last line appears to be δυσνόητα, also uncertain. Running head and page number read clearly. Catchword "de" is at the lower right. The page has no marginal notes.
